home_hero_title: Mastery is a system, not a gift.
home_hero_subtitle: We build small tools that remove the fake limits on how fast people can learn, understand, and create. We do it in public, from scratch, on a simple belief: where you start does not decide where you finish.
home_products_subtitle: Small, focused tools you can try in about a minute. Each one chips away at a constraint that should not be there.
home_koby_text: Drop in any book and turn it into an audiobook that plays right on your device, free and private, with word-level read-along. Plus beautiful charts from your Kobo highlights.
home_viz_text: A field notebook of interactive data stories. Each one turns a real dataset into something you grasp in a single glance.
home_severo_text: An adaptive language tutor built on spaced repetition and real conversation, designed to make you fluent faster. Currently in beta.
home_why_text: Most people never find out what they are capable of. Not for lack of talent, but because of constraints that look permanent and are not: credentials, track records, the need to work just to survive. We build to remove them, one tool at a time. The long game is a home where builders live with their needs covered, free to create.
home_public_text: Wins, numbers, and faceplants, all out in the open. We film the road from zero to one million, almost daily, with no magic formulas.
home_news_text: Now and then, a note on what we shipped, what broke, and what we learned. No spam, no noise.
collage_subtitle: Invent the surreal. Program the impossible.
corporate_subtitle: We build our own products and dream up a home where every builder can do the same.

davinci_subtitle: We craft software with the precision of an engineer and the soul of an artist, shaping ideas into motion.
about_subtitle: Luarai is Juan and Julia, a two-person indie studio building our own products, in public. Everything we learn, break, and ship gets shared along the way.
about_mission_text: We're a two-person software studio of the scrappy kind: we spot a friction, prototype fast, put it in front of real people, and let honest feedback decide what survives. Some bets become products, some become lessons. All of them live in our portfolio. Our own ideas are the main story.
about_vision_title: Follow the Journey: De 0 a 1 Millón
about_vision_text: Our video diary documents the road from zero to one million, almost daily, with no magic formulas. Launches and flops, AI bills and bug hunts, plus the life around it: cooking, languages, and the occasional collapse after the gym. It's the unfiltered version of building a studio from scratch (in Spanish).
about_advantage_subtitle: Why do it like this? Glad you asked.
about_advantage_1_text: Our wins, numbers, and faceplants are all out there, on YouTube, Reddit, and GitHub. Transparency keeps us honest and makes the products better.
about_advantage_2_text: Lean to the bone: small bets, fast launches, honest postmortems. Still faster than a cheetah on a skateboard.
about_advantage_3_text: Half our portfolio started as a 'what if…?'. The weird ideas get a seat at the table. That's where the good stuff comes from.
about_cta_title: Curious Where All This Is Going?
footer_text_2: Made with ♥ and a sprinkle of stardust.
vision_title: A Place Where Ideas Are Born
vision_subtitle: This is the long game: Luarai as a live-in incubator. A real, physical home where builders live for free, with food, tools, and services covered, and pour everything into their ideas. In exchange? A small slice of what they build (think ~10%). Everybody wins. Especially the ideas.
vision_today_text: Full honesty: we can't pay for anyone's groceries yet. Today, Luarai is a tiny product studio building its own things. Everything we've shipped and experimented with lives in our portfolio. The incubator isn't open. There's no application form. This page exists because we'd rather say the dream out loud than keep it in a drawer.
vision_deal_subtitle: When the doors open, here's what living at Luarai will look like.
vision_deal_1_text: A room, a desk, and good wifi. Rent is not a thing here.
vision_deal_2_text: Fed builders build better. Groceries and meals, covered.
vision_deal_3_text: Hardware, software, cloud credits, legal and admin help, all the boring-but-vital stuff, handled.
vision_deal_4_text: Live alongside people building their own crazy things. The best accelerant ever discovered.
vision_road_subtitle: No dates. No promises. Just direction.
vision_road_1_text: Now. The products in our portfolio, and whatever idea wakes us up at 3am next.
vision_road_2_text: Our own products fund the dream. No shortcuts, no magic money.
vision_road_3_text: A house, a kitchen, ridiculous wifi, and the first builders in residence.
vision_road_4_text: Companies born under our roof, each one proof that the model works.
vision_cta_title: No Applications. No Waitlist. Just a Promise.
vision_cta_subtitle: When the doors open, you'll hear it here first. Until then, we'll be building.
contact_subtitle: We love hearing from curious minds, bold dreamers, and anyone with an idea worth saying out loud. Whether it's about one of our products, the incubator dream, or just a digital high-five, our inbox is always open.

contact_location_text: We work from Earth… for now. 🌍

portfolio_subtitle: Take a peek into the universe of things we’ve built, from pixel-perfect interfaces to clever automations and bold experiments. This is where ideas meet execution, and imagination takes center stage. Warning: may cause sudden bursts of inspiration.
sanfanson_note: The exercise generator is no longer connected. Kept here as a memory of what it was.
divo_note: The online storage is disconnected, so the cloud version no longer saves. You can still run it locally and build layouts for free.
zenota_description: A visual-first note-taking app where your notes become nested bento boxes. Each box holds others and is sized by what's inside, so a whole tree of ideas sits on one calm board. Step into any box to focus, step back out to see the whole. Built for visual thinkers who want clarity and structure.
sanfanson_description: A language-learning game that uses interactive minigames and an AI-powered feedback system to make learning new languages engaging and effective. Features include leaderboards, progress tracking, and dynamic content generation.
picky_description: An interactive and intelligent digital menu for restaurants. Picky allows users to filter dishes by ingredients, allergens, and dietary needs. It also features an AI-powered admin view ("Pickyto") to help restaurant owners digitalize their menus effortlessly.
divo_description: A whimsical, visual-first web editor that lets you vibe your site into existence. Drag, drop, and tweak your way to a beautiful, responsive webpage, then export clean HTML with a single click. Built for designers, creators, and anyone who thinks coding should be more like playing.
koby_description: An insightful web app that lets you upload, visualize, and share your Kobo e-reader highlights. Koby transforms your reading data into beautiful charts and shareable insights. Now with Listen: drop in any book (EPUB, PDF, Kindle, Word and more) and turn it into an audiobook that plays entirely on your device, free, private, and with word-level read-along highlighting.
viz_description: A hand-drawn data field notebook where we pin interactive data experiments to a corkboard as they're finished. Each entry turns a real dataset into a visual story, like the World Cup 2026 chord diagram tracing every player from their country of birth to the national team they represent.
zerotoellipsis_description: The written, owned companion to our '0 to 1 Million' video diary. The name says the whole idea: not zero to one million, which is a fixed finish line, but zero to ellipsis, open-ended. Each long video is distilled into focused, evergreen entries, one teaching at a time, and every entry traces where its idea came from through a citation timeline you read from the bottom up. Built on Astro with a noir 'Arc Archive' design, full-text search, and an automated transcript-to-post pipeline.
homigo_description: The Swiss Army Knife for Domestic Services: a trust-based platform connecting homeowners with domestic service providers in Colombia. Features smart matching, transparent negotiation, escrow payments, and bidirectional reviews to solve security and informality issues in the domestic services market.
severo_description: An adaptive AI language learning tutor powered by Gemini AI. Severus uses spaced repetition (SM-2 algorithm), real-time speech recognition, and natural conversation to teach languages. Features include personalized exercises, pronunciation feedback, error tracking, gamification with achievements and leaderboards, and dynamic difficulty adjustment.
tencargo_description: A simple and accessible delivery platform designed to enable entrepreneurs and small businesses to send items with flat-rate pricing based on distance. Features include shipment creation, tracking, profile management, and delivery history. Project discontinued after market research revealed strong competition.
aeolianarmonies_description: A Sicilian mosaic-inspired aesthetic design for wind turbine towers submitted to Enel's WinDesign Challenge. The design features a contemporary geometric pattern with Mediterranean blues and golden-ochre tones that fade from dense at the base to sparse at the top, creating visual harmony with the landscape.
dailytracker_description: An experimental lifelogging system that uses AI to analyze minute-by-minute photos to automatically generate end-of-day summaries of activities, locations, and time distribution. The prototype features activity classification and data visualization to create meaningful insights from passive image capture.
languagelearninggame_description: An immersive fairy-tale inspired language learning game prototype built with Flutter. The concept combines gamification with language education through an enchanting visual experience, with AI-generated artwork creating a magical learning environment.
lorenamor_description: An experimental learning platform featuring a canvas-style node-based interface for organizing and connecting study materials. Built as a prototype to explore new ways of visualizing and interacting with educational content through an interconnected node system.
snipy_description: An AI-powered video editing prototype that transforms long-form content into viral-ready short clips. Built in 4 days, Snipy uses an 'AI Producer' agent that analyzes dialogue dynamics and speaker tracking to automatically identify and package the most compelling moments from hours of raw footage.
vibecell_description: An experimental AI-friendly spreadsheet application inspired by 'vibe coding' principles. VibeCell reimagines Excel with a WYSIWYG interface where data is organized in a structured, AI-parseable format. Users can analyze and manipulate data through natural language text instructions or voice commands.
